# Light green is at (40,8) inside the bottom gray container
# Game was GAME_OVER but became NOT_FINISHED after LEFT
# Let me check the current board state

seg = current_frame.segmentation
print("=== Key objects ===")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    boundary = n['boundary']
    min_row = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
    min_col = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
    max_row = max(p[0] for p in boundary)
    max_col = max(p[1] for p in boundary)
    if n['color'] in ['R', 'b', 'N', 'Y', 'g', 'r', 'c']:
        if n['pixels'] >= 4 or (min_row >= 20 and min_row <= 43 and min_col >= 8 and min_col <= 27):
            print(f"  {n['color']} at ({min_row},{min_col})-({max_row},{max_col}), pixels={n['pixels']}")

# Try moving light green UP to get out of the gray container
result = action(['UP', 'UP', 'UP', 'UP', 'UP'])
print(f"\nAfter 5x UP: level={current_frame.level}, step={current_frame.step}")
print(f"game_over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")

# Check light green position
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        boundary = n['boundary']
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
        print(f"Light green at ({min_row},{min_col})")
